objective: Prevent false certification of professional excellence while minimizing evaluation cost and wall-clock through relevance-gated escalation.

roots.contract: Freeze objective, audience, hard constraints, plausible interpretations, target construct and claim scope; block goal substitution and decision-relevant ambiguity.
Ensure the candidate/search space is sufficiently diverse and search closure is separated from artifact acceptance; block best-of-mediocre and local-fixation failures.
Bind claims to exact artifact bytes, delivery environment, experienced artifact and sufficient observation channels; block render, capture, hidden-surface and multiscale loss.
Establish construct validity, absolute quality floors, criterion ontology, scale/resolution and outcome-task transfer; block proxy, rubric and measurement gaming.
Qualify judges and reference standards locally by criterion, population, difficulty and state; preserve disagreement, ambiguity and reference fallibility.
Admit typed evidence with provenance, independence/common-cause accounting, grounding reachability and correct uncertainty semantics.
Separate ranking from causal explanation and edit prescription; require intervention fidelity, effect scope and post-edit verification before generalized design rules.
Bind claims to target constituency, operator/presenter, context and deployment envelope; account for representation, measurement invariance, interaction and reactivity.
Bind claims to target time horizons, temporal drift, delayed outcomes, carryover, censoring, rare events and performative/equilibrium effects where material.
Freeze or robustify defensible analysis, aggregation, compensation, threshold and risk policy; block cherry-picking, ontology/scale reversal and unjustified scalarization.
Protect dev/selection/cert separation, hidden holdouts, evaluator control plane, selection pressure and Goodhart attack surfaces; consume exposed evidence.
Require assumption-guarantee composition, joint root satisfaction on the same artifact, defeater search, challenge coverage, nonvacuity and explicit residual unknowns.
